user.title: Set up Battery Guard
user.description: Battery Guard automatically scans all devices with battery sensors and monitors their status. Only one instance is needed.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Battery Guard is already set up.

data.offline_hours: Consider offline after (hours without a report)
data.auto_log_jump_threshold: Jump threshold for automatic detection (percentage points)
data.stale_grace_hours: Grace period for orphaned devices (hours, 0 = disabled)

error.invalid_thresholds: Thresholds must be descending: Watch > Low > Critical.

log_change.name: Log battery change
log_change.description: Logs a battery change for a device monitored by Battery Guard. Updates the change history and, if given, the stored battery type.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Battery Guard device the change applies to.

quantity.name: Number of batteries
quantity.description: How many batteries of this type the device needs (default: 1). Defined as a text field so templates (e.g. from dashboard actions) also work; converted to a number internally.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional remark, e.g. brand or place of purchase.

date.name: Change date
date.description: Date of the battery change. Default if empty: today.

clear_history.name: Reset battery change history
clear_history.description: Irrevocably deletes the complete battery change history (and the stored battery type) for a device. Useful to remove test entries or to start over after replacing a device.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Battery Guard device whose history should be deleted.

set_battery_info.name: Set battery type
set_battery_info.description: Defines which battery type and how many batteries a device needs, independent of the change history. This keeps the shopping list correct even for devices where no change has ever been logged.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Battery Guard device the battery type applies to.

quantity.name: Number of batteries
quantity.description: How many batteries of this type the device needs (default: 1). Defined as a text field so templates also work; converted to a number internally.

not_battery_guard_device.message: This device does not belong to Battery Guard.

no_history.message: No battery change history is stored for this device.
